exposure: Cerebral Venous Thrombosis (CVT) during pregnancy and puerperium
cohort: Four patients diagnosed with Cerebral Venous Thrombosis during pregnancy or the postpartum period at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Prompt imaging and anticoagulation, even in cases with hemorrhagic infarction, are crucial for favorable outcomes in patients with cerebral venous thrombosis during pregnancy and the puerperium, leading to complete neurological recovery in all four studied cases.
